hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Accept the outcome-blind treatment-episode cohort as technically reproducible from the ten normalization-v2 source bundles. The frozen causal contract yields 42569 same-direction episodes and 2440 unique percentile-eligible episodes, including more than 100 episodes for each competing branch. This clears treatment-count feasibility only. Acquire and align public-flow, L2, executable-entry, fee, funding, and forward-path evidence solely for merged eligible windows under the unchanged revision-4 contract. Do not change V58 or claim a BTC-long edge before after-cost, dependence, stability, concentration, shared-portfolio, and untouched prospective tests pass.
falsifier: Reject this treatment cohort if the reproducing verifier no longer regenerates every row from the manifest-bound normalized labels, any source or output hash drifts, duplicate episode identities appear, future observations alter a prior threshold, or outcome fields are found in this artifact. Reject either strategy branch under the exact revision-4 after-cost, dependence, monthly-stability, largest-winner, shared-portfolio, and prospective criteria.

limitations: The cohort establishes treatment availability and causal threshold construction, not profitable entries or exits.
The first 3287 episodes are correctly withheld from threshold eligibility because the actual source begins on 2025-12-22 and lacks a full prior 30-day window.
Eligible percentile arms overlap; 4552 arm assignments represent 2440 unique episodes and must not be treated as independent trades.
Liquidation episodes can cluster temporally and across arms, so inference must use block bootstrap, overlap purging, and unique-episode accounting.
Public-flow, L2, executable price, fee, funding, slippage, and forward outcomes remain unacquired for this cohort.
No strategy outcome has been inspected, and no live change is supported.
